patch_description: Restructure the algorithm into a multi-strategy pipeline: (1) generate candidate placements using several greedy ordering/selection heuristics (by r/s descending, by model size, best-fit by resulting KVPR), (2) evaluate each candidate's max KVPR, then (3) apply an iterative refinement pass that greedily moves models from the hottest GPU to other GPUs when it lowers the overall max KVPR. This modular architecture explores a larger solution space and directly targets the min-max objective, improving placement quality while keeping the same interface.
